description: Fedor's express courses (plain-language explainers with a diagram per concept) on AI agents, MCP, RAG, evals, architecture, cloud and enterprise systems. Optionally filter by words in the title and summary. Returns slug, title, summary, level, reading time and URL; use get_course for the full text.

language.description: Language of the returned text: en, ru, es or zh. Defaults to en.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'mcp' or 'snowflake'; empty lists all courses.

name: list_courses
title: List courses
